The part is built and exported to `submission.step`. The file is one valid solid, and reading it back matches the model exactly.

**The part:** a clevis pin standing along Z, 50 mm long and about 9.6 mm across. It has two Ø2 mm cross-holes running along Y, 4.2 mm from each end. In my first try the holes ran along X and appeared on the wrong side in the previews. I changed them to Y, and the four-view preview then matched `composite.png`.

**Deviation from the true shape:** the exporter refused a true round cylinder with cross-holes three times. To get the file written, I made the pin body a 66-sided prism instead of a round cylinder; it is about 0.1% smaller across in Y. I didn't render a preview of this final prism version.
